sites.name: Rasuwagadhi–Kerung vehicle bridge area
sites.coordinate_method: Arithmetic mean of mapped OSM way vertices from fresh XML, approximate crossing-area marker (not survey centroid): way/1443180803
sites.precision: Approximate historical crossing area, 100 m; 2017 Bailey bridge was adjacent, not the mapped 2019 structure.
sites.evidence_note: OSM geometry is the 2019 replacement. Contemporary 2018 construction report places it five metres northeast of the old vehicle/Bailey bridge used before 2019; therefore used only as an approximate crossing-area reference for 2017, not as the 2017 structure.
